title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Construction Standards for Light Installations
content:
These construction standards set out, fixture by fixture, what the line crew may build for a light under **Area and Security Lighting Rental**: whether the fixture is installed new at all, how many additional poles may be set for one light, the longest overhead span, and whether an underground feed, a member-owned pole or a house-side shield may be used.

## Standards by fixture

| Fixture | Installed new | Most additional poles for one light | Longest overhead span, source pole to light pole (feet) | Underground feed may be installed | May be mounted on a member-owned pole meeting cooperative specifications | House-side light shield may be added | Signed easement required before a new pole is set |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LED 40W Security Light | Yes | 2 | 150 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| LED 70W Area Light | Yes | 2 | 150 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| LED 110W Flood Light | Yes | 2 | 150 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| LED 150W Flood Light | Yes | 2 | 150 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| HPS 100W Security Light | No, maintained only | 2 | 150 | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| HPS 250W Flood Light | No, maintained only | 2 | 150 | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light | No, maintained only | 2 | 150 | No | No | Yes | Yes |

## Notes on the standards

- **New and legacy fixtures.** The four LED fixtures are installed new. The HPS 100W Security Light, the HPS 250W Flood Light and the Mercury Vapor 175W Security Light are legacy fixtures: the cooperative maintains those already burning but installs none new.
- **Additional poles.** Two is the most additional poles set for one light, whatever the fixture. One or two additional poles are within the standard; a third is not.
- **Overhead span.** The span from the source pole to the light pole is at most 150 feet. A span of exactly 150 feet is within the standard; 151 feet is not.
- **Underground feed and member-owned poles** are available with the LED fixtures only.
- **Shields** may be added to every fixture.
- **Easements.** For every fixture, a new pole is not set until the easement for it is signed.
